arxiv-2111-05085.title: S S -unit values of G n + G m G_{n}+G_{m} in function fields Thanks: Supported by Austrian Science Fund (FWF) under project I4406 and I4945-N
arxiv-2111-05085.creator: Sebastian Heintze
arxiv-2111-05085.description: Abstract . In this paper we consider a simple linear recurrence sequence G n G_{n} defined over a function field in one variable over the field of complex numbers. We prove an upper bound on the indices n n and m m such that G n + G m G_{n}+G_{m} is an S S -unit.

arxiv-2202-00078.title: A heteroencoder architecture for prediction of failure locations in porous metals using variational inference
arxiv-2202-00078.creator: Wyatt Bridgman, Xiaoxuan Zhang, Greg Teichert, [0.05in] Mohammad Khalil, Krishna Garikipati, Reese Jones, [0.1in] Sandia National Laboratories, Livermore, CA
arxiv-2202-00078.description: Abstract In this work we employ an encoder-decoder convolutional neural network to predict the failure locations of porous metal tension specimens based only on their initial porosities. The process we model is complex, with a progression from initial void nucleation, to saturation, and ultimately failure.

arxiv-2203-08057.title: Poetree: Interpretable Policy Learning with Adaptive Decision Trees
arxiv-2203-08057.creator: Alizée Pace, Alex J. Chan, Mihaela van der Schaar
arxiv-2203-08057.description: Abstract Building models of human decision-making from observed behaviour is critical to better understand, diagnose and support real-world policies such as clinical care. As established policy learning approaches remain focused on imitation performance, they fall short of explaining the demonstrated decision-making process.

arxiv-2209-02527.title: What is the most general class of quasiprobabilities of work?
arxiv-2209-02527.creator: Gianluca Francica
arxiv-2209-02527.description: Abstract How to give a statistical description of thermodynamics in quantum systems is an open fundamental question. Concerning the work, the presence of initial quantum coherence in the energy basis can give rise to a quasiprobability of work, which can take negative values. Our aim is to identify the most general quasiprobability of work satisfying some fundamental conditions.

arxiv-2303-13812.title: RECTANGULAR MATRIX ADDITIONS IN LOW AND HIGH TEMPERATURES
arxiv-2303-13812.creator: Jiaming Xu
arxiv-2303-13812.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Jiaming Xu. We study the addition of two random independent M × N M\times N rectangular random matrices with invariant distributions in two limit regimes, where the parameter beta (inverse temperature) goes to infinity and zero. In low temperature regime the random singular values of the sum concentrate at deterministic points, while in high temperature regime we obtain a Law of Large Numbers for the empirical measures. As a consequence, we deliver a duality between low and high temperatures.

arxiv-2305-18253.title: A new upper bound for the Heilbronn triangle problem
arxiv-2305-18253.creator: Alex Cohen, Cosmin Pohoata, Dmitrii Zakharov
arxiv-2305-18253.description: Abstract For sufficiently large n n , we show that in every configuration of n n points chosen inside the unit square there exists a triangle of area less than n − 8 / 7 − 1 / 2000 n^{-8/7-1/2000} . This improves upon a result of Komlós, Pintz and Szemerédi from 1982.

arxiv-2308-01980.title: Majorana zero modes in quantum Hall edges survive edge reconstruction
arxiv-2308-01980.creator: Kishore Iyer, Amulya Ratnakar, Sumathi Rao, Sourin Das
arxiv-2308-01980.description: Abstract A smooth edge potential on a ν = 1 \nu=1 quantum Hall system leads to a ν = 1 / 3 \nu=1/3 side strip, which could yield both Majorana and parafermion zero modes at the domain wall of the superconductor and ferromagnet on the edge.

arxiv-2312-08928.title: Phase Memory of Orbital Angular Momentum in Multiple Scattering Environment
arxiv-2312-08928.creator: Igor Meglinski, Ivan Lopushenko, Anton Sdobnov, Alexander Bykov
arxiv-2312-08928.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Igor Meglinski, Ivan Lopushenko, Anton Sdobnov, Alexander Bykov. Recent advancements in wavefront shaping techniques have facilitated the study of complex structured light’s propagation with orbital angular momentum (OAM) within various media. The introduction of a spiral phase modulation to the Laguerre–Gaussian (LG) beam during its paraxial propagation is facilitated by the negative gradient of the medium’s refractive index’s temporal change, resulting in an accelerated retardation in OAM twist.

arxiv-2402-11089.title: The Male CEO and the Female Assistant: Evaluation and Mitigation of Gender Biases in Text-To-Image Generation of Dual Subjects
arxiv-2402-11089.creator: Yixin Wan, Kai-Wei Chang
arxiv-2402-11089.description: Abstract Recent large-scale T2I models like DALLE-3 have made progress in reducing gender stereotypes when generating single-person images. However, significant biases remain when generating images with more than one person. To systematically evaluate this, we propose the Paired Stereotype Test (PST) framework, which queries T2I models to depict two individuals assigned with male-stereotyped and female-stereotyped social identities, respectively (e.g.

arxiv-2408-15454.title: BayesSRW: Bayesian Sampling and Re-weighting approach for variance reduction
arxiv-2408-15454.creator: Carol Liu
arxiv-2408-15454.description: Abstract In this paper, we address the challenge of sampling in scenarios where limited resources prevent exhaustive measurement across all subjects. We consider a setting where samples are drawn from multiple groups, each following a distribution with unknown mean and variance parameters.

arxiv-2508-04080.title: GeoSR: Cognitive-Agentic Framework for Probing Geospatial Knowledge Boundaries via Iterative Self-Refinement Thanks: wuyk0@scu.edu.cn
arxiv-2508-04080.creator: Jinfan Tang, Kunming Wu, Ruifeng Gongxie, Yuya He, Yuankai Wu
arxiv-2508-04080.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Jinfan Tang, Kunming Wu, Ruifeng Gongxie, Yuya He, Yuankai Wu. Recent studies have extended the application of large language models (LLMs) to geographic problems, revealing surprising geospatial competence even without explicit spatial supervision. However, LLMs still face challenges in spatial consistency, multi-hop reasoning, and geographic bias. To address these issues, we propose GeoSR , a self-refining agentic reasoning framework that embeds core geographic principles—most notably Tobler’s First Law of Geography—into an iterative prediction loop.

arxiv-2509-12789.title: Holey sheets: Double-Threshold Rupture of Draining Liquid Films
arxiv-2509-12789.creator: Ayush K. Dixit, Chunheng Zhao, Stéphane Zaleski, Detlef Lohse, Vatsal Sanjay
arxiv-2509-12789.description: Abstract Classical rupture is attributed to molecular (van der Waals) forces acting at nanometric thicknesses. Nonetheless, micron-thick liquid sheets routinely perforate far above the scale where these molecular forces act, yet the mechanism that selects opening versus healing has remained unclear.

arxiv-2512-12796.title: Optimal design for the planar Skorokhod embedding problem
arxiv-2512-12796.creator: Maher Boudabra
arxiv-2512-12796.description: Abstract We revisit the planar Skorokhod embedding problem introduced by Gross and developed further by Boudabra-Markowsky, and we place it in a fully variational framework. For a centered probability measure μ \mu with finite second moment, we show that Gross’ μ \mu -domain U μ G U_{\mu}^{G} uniquely minimizes the area among all simply connected μ \mu -domains.

pmc-11312503.title: Genome-Wide Identification and Evolution-Profiling Analysis of TPS Gene Family in Triticum Plants
pmc-11312503.creator: Yiyang Liu, Dongyang Li, Yue Liu, Jiazheng Wang, Chang Liu
pmc-11312503.description: Terpenoids play a crucial role in plant growth and development, as well as in regulating resistance mechanisms. Terpene synthase (TPS) serves as the final step in the synthesis process of terpenoids. However, a comprehensive bioinformatics analysis of the TPS gene family in Triticum plants had not previously been systematically undertaken.

pmc-11343602.title: IL-27/Blimp-1 axis regulates the differentiation and function of Tim-3+ Tregs during early pregnancy
pmc-11343602.creator: Si-Jia Zhao, Xiao-Hui Hu, Xin-Xiu Lin, Yu-Jing Zhang, Jing Wang, Huan Wang, Guang-Shun Gong, Gil Mor, Ai-Hua Liao
pmc-11343602.description: Decidual regulatory T cells (Tregs) are essential for successful pregnancy outcome. A subset of Tregs, T cell immunoglobulin and mucin domain-containing protein 3–positive regulatory T cells (TregsTim-3+), plays a central role in the acceptance of the fetus during early stages of normal pregnancy. The molecular mechanism regulating the differentiation and function of TregsTim-3+ is unknown.

pmc-11445999.title: Drivers and barriers of seasonal influenza vaccination 2015/16 & 2019/20 to 2022/23 - a survey on why most Norwegians don’t get the flu vaccine
pmc-11445999.creator: Birgitte Klüwer, Kjersti Margrethe Rydland, Svenn-Erik Mamelund, Rebecca Nybru Gleditsch
pmc-11445999.description: BackgroundThis study aimed to explore the reasons adults in the general population, influenza risk groups (RGs) and health care workers (HCWs) in Norway give for their vaccination choices and whether these reasons vary between groups or over time in order to further improve influenza vaccination coverage.

pmc-11667643.title: In the Era of Molecular Pathology, the Role of Morphological Changes in Megakaryocytes in Bone Marrow Aspiration in Cases of Isolated Thrombocytopenia
pmc-11667643.creator: Deepshikha Verma, Lal Pranay Singh, Preeti Mandloi, Rajnikant Ahirwar
pmc-11667643.description: Background: The most typical cause of thrombocytopenia is immune-mediated thrombocytopenic purpura (ITP). Thrombocytopenia can cause insufficient clot formation and increase the risk of bleeding. Bone marrow aspiration is commonly used for this purpose. ITP was primarily caused by immune-mediated platelet destruction and a megakaryocyte maturation abnormality.

pmc-12405875.title: Screening of cellulose-degrading bacteria and its degradation and growth-promoting applications
pmc-12405875.creator: Mengke Chen, Xuebin Li, Er Meng, Changjun Liu, Qinyu Li
pmc-12405875.description: More than one billion tons of chaff waste are generated globally every year, but traditional recycling methods face the dual challenges of inefficiency and environmental risks, to solve this problem, this study innovatively achieves the dual functions of lignocellulosic synergistic degradation and plant promotion by constructing synthetic microbial communities.

pmc-12521016.title: Integrating surgery into multimodal treatment for locally advanced pancreatic cancer: beyond the boundaries of systemic therapy
pmc-12521016.creator: Artur Rebelo, Jörg Kleeff

pmc-12722424.title: Interplay Between Enteroendocrine Hormone (Leptin) and Adipokines (Ghrelin and Adiponectin) with Gastric Expression of FTO and MC4R Genes
pmc-12722424.creator: Mohamed Hany, Mona K. ElDeeb, Ehab Elmongui, Anwar Ashraf Abouelnasr, Noha A. El-Banna, Sahar M. Omer, Sara A. Shaker, Rasha A. ElTahan
pmc-12722424.description: Obesity is a complex, multifactorial disease influenced by genetic, hormonal, and metabolic factors. The fat mass and obesity-associated (FTO) and melanocortin 4 receptor (MC4R) genes have been implicated in body weight regulation through gut–brain signaling and their interactions with adipokines and enteroendocrine hormones.

pmc-12737530.title: A Small-Molecular-Weight Bacteriocin-like Inhibitory Substance (BLIS) UI-11 Produced by Lactobacillus plantarum HYH-11 as an Antimicrobial Agent for Aeromonas hydrophila
pmc-12737530.creator: Yinghui He, Donghui Tang, Jiarui Lin, Jiayue Zhang, Wanli Sha, Wenlong Dong, Teresa Encinas, Pablo Morón-Elorza, Manuel Fuertes-Recuero
pmc-12737530.description: Simple SummaryThis study aims to explore the potential of the bacteriocin-like inhibitory substance (BLIS) UI-11 from lactic acid bacteria as a novel therapeutic agent in aquaculture. The primary objectives are to evaluate its efficacy in substituting for antibiotics against A. hydrophila infections and to elucidate its antibacterial mechanism.

pmc-13023993.title: Pulmonary Arterial Hypertension: From Molecular Basis to Therapeutic Approaches

pmc-13063795.title: Safety and efficacy of a feed additive consisting of a proanthocyanidin‐rich dry extract from the fruit of Vaccinium macrocarpon Aiton (cranberry extract) for dogs and cats (ACEL pharma S.r.l.)
pmc-13063795.creator: EFSA Panel on Additives and Products or Substances used in Animal Feed (FEEDAP), Roberto Edoardo Villa, Giovanna Azimonti, Eleftherios Bonos, Henrik Christensen, Mojca Durjava, Ronette Gehring, Boet Glandorf, Maryline Kouba, Marta López‐Alonso, Francesca Marcon, Carlo Nebbia, Alena Pechová, Miguel P

The additive is not currently authorised for use in feed.

pmc-13096526.title: Combining AI to reveal CCDC3-mediated pathways of colorectal cancer liver metastasis
pmc-13096526.creator: Runze Huang, Qinyu Liu, Xin Jin, Xuanci Bai, Yibin Wu, Xigan He, Yixiu Wang, Ziting Jiang, Yongfa Zhang, Yi Shi, Lu Wang, Weiping Zhu
pmc-13096526.description: In colorectal cancer liver metastases, chromosomal instability (CIN) serves as a critical hallmark linked to tumor aggressiveness and poor prognosis. This study integrated single-cell RNA sequencing, weighted gene co-expression network analysis, and non-negative matrix factorization to construct a comprehensive CIN index, revealing that CIN-high tumor cells exhibit more aggressive phenotypes and reside in an immune-excluded tumor microenvironment.

pmc-13287908.title: 16: Functional Screening of ARID1A-Deficient Cholangiocarcinoma Using the MAPS Platform
pmc-13287908.creator: Wenjia Wang, Olivia Schmidt, Sara K Blick-Nitko, Aslihan Ambeskovic, Diana Agostini-Vulaj, Hartmut K Land, Isaac S Harris, Aram F Hezel
pmc-13287908.description: Background & ObjectivesCholangiocarcinoma (CCA) is an aggressive malignancy characterized by a high frequency of chromatin-remodeling gene alterations and has limited therapeutic options. Approximately 47% of intrahepatic CCA cases present alterations in at least one gene associated with chromatin remodeling with loss-of-function mutations in ARID1A occurring in ∼19-22% of cases. However, actionable vulnerabilities associated with ARID1A deficiency remain poorly defined.

pmc-13339285.title: Altered hypothalamic metabolism in chronic cluster headache patients measured with 1H-MRS at ultra-high magnetic field
pmc-13339285.creator: Avneesh Jain, Anna Xiu Rørnes, Anne Farestveit, Maria Tunset Grinde, Axel Karl Gottfrid Nyman, Beathe Sitter, Tore Wergeland, Erling Tronvik, Guglielmo Genovese
pmc-13339285.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundThe hypothalamus is considered a central hub in the pathophysiology of cluster headache (CH), yet its neurochemical profile remains poorly understood. Proton magnetic resonance spectroscopy (1H-MRS) offers a non-invasive tool for in vivo assessment of brain metabolites related to neuronal integrity and energy metabolism, but previous studies in CH have been restricted to conventional magnetic field scanner (≤ 3 T), which has resulted in limited metabolic information.
